title: 无字经书
subtitle: 看见空白，也敢提出疑问
origin: 《西游记》第九十八回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 尊重不等于不提问，认真检查和礼貌求证能保护重要的成果。
moral.en: Respect does not mean silence; careful checking and courteous questions protect important work.

pages.zh: 师徒走进大殿，两位守经人搬来整整齐齐的经卷，装满了他们的行囊。
pages.en: The travelers entered the great hall, where two scripture keepers filled their packs with neatly stacked scrolls.
pages.prompt: The established team enters a serene luminous Buddhist-inspired hall. Two kind adult scripture keepers in simple saffron-and-ivory robes place closed blank scrolls into travel cases; no readable religious text or imposing statues.

pages.zh: 八戒抱着沉甸甸的经包，开心得直喘气：“终于取到了！”
pages.en: Bajie hugged the heavy scripture bundle and puffed happily. "We finally have them!"
pages.prompt: Bajie cheerfully hugs a large but manageable cloth-wrapped scroll bundle while Wukong, Sha, Tang Seng, and White Dragon Horse smile; bright temple courtyard, no text.

pages.zh: 一阵风吹开卷角，白龙马看见纸面一片空白，轻轻用鼻尖碰了碰悟空。
pages.en: A breeze lifted one scroll corner. White Dragon Horse saw a blank page and gently nudged Wukong.
pages.prompt: Close scene: a breeze reveals one completely blank cream scroll page as White Dragon Horse gently nudges Wukong; surprised curiosity, no writing or hidden symbols.

pages.zh: 悟空又抽查三卷：没有字，也没有图。他没有发火，只请大家先停下来一起核对。
pages.en: Wukong checked three more scrolls: no words, no pictures. He did not grow angry; he asked everyone to pause and verify together.
pages.prompt: Wukong calmly opens three blank scrolls on a low table while the team gathers around; his red-and-gold staff rests safely upright, thoughtful expressions, no anger.

pages.zh: 守经人说，有些道理本来就藏在空白里。唐僧回答：“可我们还要带回去让许多人学习。”
pages.en: The keepers said that some truths live in silence. Tang Seng replied, "But we must bring teachings home for many people to study."
pages.prompt: Tang Seng and the two kind scripture keepers converse respectfully across a low table of blank scrolls; equal posture, Wukong listening, warm calm light, no confrontation.

pages.zh: 沙僧拿出铜台府的证明和通关文牒，说明一路使命；八戒则数清每个箱子，避免再次拿错。
pages.en: Sha presented their sealed travel documents, while Bajie counted every case so nothing would be mixed up again.
pages.prompt: Sha Wujing presents rolled sealed documents with no visible writing; Bajie counts closed scripture cases using plain pebbles; the keepers observe, orderly verification.

pages.zh: 守经人重新查看库房，发现两批经卷放反了。他们认真道歉，带师徒去取有字的真经。
pages.en: The keepers checked the archive and found that two sets had been reversed. They apologized and led the travelers to the written scriptures.
pages.prompt: The scripture keepers discover two clearly separated shelves—blank scrolls and sealed decorated scrolls—with color-coded ribbons but no text; they bow apologetically and guide the team onward.

pages.zh: 悟空把无字经卷放回原位：“空白可以让人思考，但交付之前，也要先问清用途。”
pages.en: Wukong returned the blank scrolls. "Silence can invite thought, but before giving something, we must understand its purpose."
pages.prompt: Wukong carefully returns blank scrolls to their shelf while Tang Seng and the keepers nod; orderly archive, soft gold light, lesson of careful communication, no readable labels.
